product.title: Sunset Wildlife Tour (Wildside 4x4 Tours)

description.text: Discover the natural beauty of Colorado–and explore spots you might otherwise have missed–on this small-group wildlife tour of Rocky Mountain National Park from Estes Park, complete with heated vehicle, sunset views, and plenty of photo opportunities. Discover more about the landscape with stories and insights from a guide, pass by the Alluvial Fan waterfall, and look out for elk and deer in Moraine Park.Take the guesswork out of exploring Rocky Mountain National Park Stop at picturesque locatio Timed-entry coordination, local commentary, and photo stops are handled so you can focus on Colorado's high-country scenery. Ideal for travelers basing in Estes Park or the Front Range who want a guided Rocky Mountain National Park outing without self-driving mountain roads.
